values.name: Charge payment currency
values.description: The currency in which charges are to be paid.

values.name: Reference currency
values.description: The currency applicable to amounts stated. It may have to be converted.

values.name: Target currency
values.description: The currency which should be used to the target destination of the transaction.

values.name: Transport document currency
values.description: Currency applicable to amounts stated in a transport document/message.

values.name: Calculation base currency
values.description: Currency on which the calculation is based.

values.name: Information Currency
values.description: Additional currency the message recipient needs for information purposes. The actual message amount(s) is/are not based upon this currency.

values.name: Currency of the account
values.description: Currency in which the account is held.
